pins.notes: Polarity band side (SOD-523 style 1). Connect to the protected signal line.

gaps: No layout guidelines in the datasheet (placement near the connector, GND return) - application note AND8308/D or AND8307/D not read.
No IR, VBR, VC or capacitance over temperature: all electrical characteristics are at TA = 25 C only (p3).
No VBR max and no VBR typ given; only VBR min 6.2 V at 1 mA (p3).
Capacitance is typ only (80 pF at 0 V); no max and no curve versus bias voltage in this revision.
No IEC 61000-4-2 clamping voltage number for ESD5Z5.0: only oscilloscope screenshots (Figures 1 and 2, p3).
No recommended operating temperature range distinct from TJ/Tstg -55 to +150 C (p2).
Pin 1 cathode / pin 2 anode taken from the p1 package drawing and the p5 case outline (STYLE 1); the datasheet has no pin table.
